papers.key_finding: Diffusion equilibrates in reaction-diffusion systems whose chemical reaction network is either pseudo-detailed balanced or complex balanced, with the constraints on reaction fluxes originating from distinct stoichiometric properties.
papers.title: Identifying Non-Ideal Reaction-Diffusion Systems Unable to Maintain Diffusion Out-of-Equilibrium
papers.tldr: This preprint develops a Lyapunov-function-based method to prove that diffusion equilibrates in non-ideal reaction-diffusion systems when the reaction network is pseudo-detailed balanced or complex balanced, even under chemostat driving.
papers.why_relevant: This work extends systems-theoretic tools for non-ideal reaction-diffusion systems relevant to biomolecular control and synthetic biology, aligning with Fangzhou's focus on systems theory for biomachines.
